sources.title: README.md
sources.locator: What you get; Download; Telemetry; Building from Source; License
sources.finding: Free MIT desktop app for macOS/Windows/Linux with iOS companion. Parallel agents/worktrees, editable artifacts, tasks, diff approval and Git tools. PostHog opt-out in Settings Advanced Analytics. Collaboration sync server is separate.

sources.title: docs/FEATURE_INVENTORY.md
sources.locator: AI Providers; Workstreams; Multi-Agent; Git Integration; Mobile; Collaboration; Web Console; Tracker System; Automations; CLI and Remote Execution
sources.finding: Current feature inventory documents native Android, team browser documents/trackers, product CLI, child-session orchestration with result reporting, scheduled recurring tasks, PR review/merge, team roles, and user-account Cloudflare/headless execution with explicit ephemeral/permission limitations.

sources.title: docs/TRACKER_WORKFLOWS.md
sources.finding: tracker_create/list/update/link_session tools maintain typed issues with priority, labels, descriptions, stable room-scoped issue keys and states; Fixes commit references move an item to done.

sources.title: LICENSE
sources.finding: Public application repository source uses MIT license.

sources.title: LICENSING.md
sources.finding: Collaboration sync server is a separate project; the application repository license does not establish its license or hosted parity.

sources.title: Release v0.82.7
sources.finding: Release v0.82.7 was published 2026-11-04 and is marked as a pre-release on GitHub. Release notes describe the scoped changes; this is not a hands-on check.

sources.title: Release v0.81.7
sources.finding: Release v0.81.7, published 2026-10-16, is the latest GitHub release not marked as a pre-release. This is not a hands-on check.

sources.title: Nimbalyst Antigravity support at v0.83.0
sources.finding: Nimbalyst v0.83.0 calls the Antigravity language server's stateless GetModelResponse RPC and implements its own conversation and tool-call loop. This is a model transport, not an Antigravity CLI or ACP agent session.

sources.title: Nimbalyst Pricing
sources.locator: Plan cards and FAQ "How much does Wiki Teams cost?"
sources.finding: The Nimbalyst app and personal wiki are free ($0). Wiki Teams, labelled Beta, is $20 per user per month or $200 per user per year and is free to use during the Beta; it adds one shared team wiki.
